points: Meanwhile, trim the carrot (no need to peel), then slice into rounds about 1cm thick. Trim the green beans, then cut into thirds.
Pour the boiled water into a large saucepan with ¼ tsp salt on high heat. Add the rice and cook for 12-13 mins.
Once cooked, drain in a sieve and pop back in the pan. Cover with a lid and leave to the side until ready to serve.
steps.title: Cook the Rice

points: While the rice cooks, heat a drizzle of oil in a large frying pan on medium-high heat.
Once hot, add the carrot and green beans and stir-fry until starting to soften, 4-5 mins.
steps.title: Stir-Fry the Veg

points: Meanwhile, peel and grate the garlic (or use a garlic press).
Zest the lime, then cut into wedges (see ingredients for amount). Drain the prawns.

notes.text: Wash your hands and equipment after handling raw prawns

steps.title: Finish your Prep

points: Add the garlic and Thai green style paste to the veg and stir-fry for 30 secs.
Stir in the coconut milk and veg stock paste. Bring to the boil, then lower the heat and simmer until the veg is almost tender, 3-4 mins.
Next, stir in the prawns and cook for another 5-6 mins.

notes.text: The prawns are cooked when pink on the outside and opaque in the middle

steps.title: Cook the Curry

points: While the curry simmers, fluff up the rice with a fork and stir through the lime zest.
Once the prawns are cooked, remove the pan from the heat and season with salt, pepper and a squeeze of lime juice.
steps.title: Finish Up

points: Share the rice out between your bowls and spoon over the prawn curry.
Serve any remaining lime wedges on the side for squeezing over.
steps.title: Serve
